name: click
description: Performs a mouse click. Can click raw pixel coordinates (x, y), a Set-of-Marks mark ID (mark_id), or a semantic UIA control (element_name, element_role).

clicks.description: Number of clicks: 1 for single click, 2 for double click, 3 for triple click.

coords_mode.description: Coordinate space for (x, y): 'pixel' for screen pixels, 'normalized_1000' for [0..1000].

element_name.description: Semantic element name from inspect_ui to click (e.g. 'File', 'Save', 'Open').

mark_id.description: Mark badge ID from a previous SOM screenshot. Directly resolves to exact center coordinates.

query.description: Universal semantic click query. Can be any button name, folder, tab, menu, or taskbar icon (e.g. 'Downloads', 'Save', 'File Explorer', 'Start'). Resolves to exact center coordinates in <0.2s without taking a screenshot.

target.description: Optional window title substring to target. Restricts interaction to this window and ensures it is focused.

x.description: X coordinate to click (screen pixel or normalized [0..1000]).

y.description: Y coordinate to click (screen pixel or normalized [0..1000]).
